mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary regime that raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 YoY change falls below -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which depresses consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) when UNRATE exceeds 6% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for four consecutive months indicates contraction in manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings visibility and increases risk aversion, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during four consecutive months of INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a fall in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 1% over two months signals a disinflationary tightening, which increases real interest rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls below 1% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated rise in both real personal income (proxied by PAYEMS) and real retail sales (proxied by RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and RSAFS both above 12-month MA
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both PAYEMS and RSAFS exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in the unemployment rate below 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate higher corporate pricing power.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE is below 4% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average for five consecutive months signals a recovery in residential construction, which boosts related equity sectors and supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average for five consecutive months.
